_comment: WALKTHROUGH — the whole of one piece of work, end to end, as pages of LISTS he scrolls. Shown twice: before building (drawings, suggested checks) and after (screenshots, check results). Same pages both times, so the second read is quick.
A list row stands unless he opens its pencil and types. He can drag a rectangle on any picture. A list he leaves untouched is accepted when he moves to the next page — there is no button to press.

Pages, in this order (Destin, 2026-11-10): 1 What you asked for and what you got · 2 Every screen that changed · 3 Behind the scenes · 4 Choices I made · 5 Checks, ending with what is left for him to verify. Drop a page that would be empty; never add a sixth.
The work is FINISHED when he has gone through this deck after the build and changed nothing. There is no separate sign-off deck.
